phobos.x: Inner Martian moon transformed into an orbital transfer terminal and cable counterweight before its catastrophic de-orbiting in the 2061 revolution.
Virtual panopticon carved into Phobos where digital minds are subjected to endless iterated Prisoner’s Dilemmas by the Archons.

venus.x: Subterranean tunnels and launch stations carved into Venus by the mysterious extinct Heechee civilization, leading to the Heechee asteroid base Gateway.
venus.a: Hal Clement, Robert L. Forward, Allen Steele, Poul Anderson

venus.x: First planetary atmosphere probed (Venera 4) and first robotic surface landing on another world (Venera 7 in 1970).

luhman-16.x: Brown dwarf binary system occupied by a massive Lanky seeding fleet, threatening the immediate Solar neighborhood.

trappist-1-e.x: Prime Earth-sized habitable-zone target in the TRAPPIST-1 system subjected to exhaustive atmospheric reconnaissance by JWST NIRSpec and MIRI.

teegarden-s-star-d.x: Earth-mass exoplanet orbiting within the habitable zone of an ultra-cool red dwarf 12.5 light-years from Earth, confirmed in 2024.
